title: Clean payment-history rate, pre-2023 customers with a loan
prompt: Among customers who joined before 2023 and have at least one loan, what fraction have NEVER had a late or missed payment across any of their loans?
population: Customers who joined before 2023-01-01 and have at least one loan.
metricDefinition: customers (joined before 2023, has ≥1 loan) with zero late/missed loan_payments across all their loans, divided by all such customers.
transformationPlan: find customers who joined before 2023 and have ≥1 loan
find which customers have ever had a late or missed loan payment, on any loan
count loan-holding pre-2023 customers not in that bad-payment set
divide by all loan-holding pre-2023 customers
referenceSql: WITH loan_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM loans WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE joined_at < DATE '2023-01-01')), bad_payment_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.customer_id FROM loans l JOIN loan_payments lp ON lp.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE lp.status IN ('late', 'missed')) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE lc.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM bad_payment_customers))::DOUBLE / count(*) AS clean_payment_rate FROM loan_customers lc
